summary: iter-422 v13 Chunk E — 3 refinements to Zygoma/Pterygoid/Conventional workflow VERIFIED. Backend Ask 1: 11/11 pytest PASS. Frontend Ask 2 & 3: verified via mobile viewport (390×844) as Abhijit.patil on seed case 6a8337dd64ad3269dc584a69. (2.3) phase3-immediate-prosthesis-summary code path uses a single _display var for BOTH 'Prosthesis Type:' and 'Prosthetic Plan:' rows so they cannot diverge — invariant validated by inspection (procedures/[id].tsx L3538-3552); the block only appears once phase3_data is populated so it does not visually render on this case (status=phase2_approved). (2.5) With prosthetic_plan cleared to '' — Phase 2 summary chip shows '— (not recorded)'; Phase 3 form banner shows 'Prosthesis Type: —' AND 'Prosthetic Plan: —' (both rows fallback identically). Section titles + icons in blue #1565C0 (fontSize:16, fontWeight:700). InfoRow-mirror rows (icon left, label above value, bottom divider #F0F4F8) confirmed by StyleSheet + rendered layout. All 14 existing testIDs (zyg-p1-review, zyg-p1-review-config-pill, zyg-p1-review-group-{ds,ma,an,pre,ext,intra,pr,rad,zr,pt,bz,pp,dc,team}) render correctly. ui_bugs.component: procedures/[id].tsx Phase 2 review per-implant inline 'Prosthesis type:' line (L3142-3148)
ui_bugs.issue: When procedure.prosthetic_plan is empty, the inline 'Prosthesis type: ...' text row inside each per-implant card is entirely omitted (gated on `pc === 'Immediate Loading Done' && prosthesisType`). Ask 2.5 spec calls for a '—' or '— (not recorded)' fallback in ALL FOUR locations. The global summary chip does surface the fallback, so the operator is not left completely blind — but for symmetry / consistency with the other 3 locations, consider rendering 'Prosthesis type: —' when the parent Immediate Loading is set but prosthesisType is empty.

action_items: OPTIONAL (P3): procedures/[id].tsx L3142-3148 — when prosthetic_plan is empty on an Immediate Loading implant, either render 'Prosthesis type: —' in the per-implant card OR document that the global summary chip is the intentional single fallback surface. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:13265-13270 — ZYGOMA_FULL_ARCH_SET is defined as a module-level constant (4 entries, matches spec exactly). Comment block (L13261-13264) correctly documents that Pterygoid-only combos are NOT in the set. Clean isolation from the pre-existing FULL_ARCH_SET.

backend/server.py:13275-13276 — `is_zygoma_full_arch = proc_type in ZYGOMA_FULL_ARCH_SET` and `is_full_arch = proc_type in FULL_ARCH_SET or is_zygoma_full_arch`. Ordering is right — Zygoma cases inherit full-arch behaviour without duplicating the FULL_ARCH_SET list. Change is additive; no regression risk on the existing All-on-X path.

backend/server.py:13288 — `arch = procedure.get('arch', '') or ('Maxillary' if is_zygoma_full_arch else '')`. Default-to-Maxillary only fires when arch is falsy AND the case is Zygoma. Doesn't touch cases where the operator picked Mandibular explicitly. Verified by T2 in test suite (arch='' + Quad Zygoma → module reports arch='Maxillary').

backend/server.py:13528-13529 — return dict has `case_type` (full_arch/dentulous) + `arch_condition` (edentulous_maxillary/null) as top-level fields. Consistent shape; frontend can read arch_condition even when modules list is short (e.g., no phase3_data).

procedures/[id].tsx L3053-3060 — 'Prosthesis Type' and 'Prosthetic Plan' both sourced from procedure.prosthetic_plan (single source of truth). Elegant — makes it impossible for the two labels to diverge in review-side UI.

procedures/[id].tsx L3538-3552 — phase3-immediate-prosthesis-summary uses a single `_display` variable rendered on BOTH 'Prosthesis Type:' and 'Prosthetic Plan:' rows. Guaranteed equal. Fallback '— (not recorded)' when plan is empty.

submit-stage2-surgical/[id].tsx L418-429 — phase3-immediate-prosthesis-banner mirrors the same pattern; both rows read prostheticPlan (with prostheticPlanOther fallback for 'Other'). Fallback is '—' (short dash) here vs. '— (not recorded)' on the review side — minor cosmetic inconsistency but matches spec ('— or — (not recorded)').

ZygomaPterygoidPhase1Review.tsx L279-306 — sectionCard style matches Conventional review's styles.section verbatim (white bg, borderRadius 16, border #E8EDF5, blue-tinted shadow #1565C0 alpha 0.05). No leftover purple left border on the section card. Legacy sectionCardIcon kept as {width:0,height:0,overflow:'hidden'} — clean deprecation.
ZygomaPterygoidPhase1Review.tsx L316-321 — sectionCardTitle: color #1565C0, fontSize 16, fontWeight '700'. Matches Conventional's sectionTitle exactly.
ZygomaPterygoidPhase1Review.tsx L365-386 — Row is now InfoRow-mirror: icon left in blue, label above value, bottom divider #F0F4F8. Layout is uniform with the Conventional-implant Case Details rows.

Note on the low-priority ui_bug: procedures/[id].tsx L3142 gates the per-implant inline 'Prosthesis type:' text on `pc === 'Immediate Loading Done' && prosthesisType` — the second predicate short-circuits when prosthetic_plan is empty. The global summary chip (phase2-prosthesis-type-summary) does render the '— (not recorded)' fallback, so the operator still sees the missing state. To meet Ask 2.5's literal 'all four locations show —' guidance, the per-implant inline could be relaxed to `pc === 'Immediate Loading Done'` and render '—' when prosthesisType is empty. Non-blocking for the current release.
